notes: Image signing with cosign is NOT done — cosign is not installed and adding release tooling is a separate decision.
This manifest is SSH-signed instead, which binds the image id and SBOM hashes to a verifiable key.
Verify with: ssh-keygen -Y verify -f release/allowed_signers -I <email> -n file -s release/RELEASE.json.sig < release/RELEASE.json
